THE KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATIONS COUNCIL
 SCHOOL BASED ASSESSMENT– 2023
 Physical Education and Sports- Grade 7
 Performance Based Assessment Tasks - Scoring Guide
 (Regular)
Key for rating the learner’s performance.
 i. Performance Level 4 (PL 4) (Exceeding Expectation) indicates that the learner has not
 only perfected /mastered the required skill but also exhibits exemplary skills that are above
 those required of his/her grade/age.
 ii. Performance Level 3 (PL 3) (Meeting Expectation) indicates that the learner has
 acquired the required skill.
 iii. Performance Level 2 (PL 2) (Approaching Expectation) indicates that the learner has
 acquired some skills but has not fully mastered them.
 iv. Performance Level 2 (PL 1) (Below Expectation) indicates that the learner is yet to
 develop the specified skills.

Scoring Guide for Task 1: High dribble in Handball (7 marks)
1. Use the Observation checklist provided to assess each learner as they perform the
 assessment task.
2. Rate the learner’s competency in performing the high dribble under four performance
 levels as follows:
 i. Performance Level 4 (PL 4) (Exceeding Expectation) where the learner correctly
 demonstrates competency in all the 7 attributes of the skill.
 ii. Performance Level 3 (PL 3) (Meeting Expectation) where the learner correctly
 demonstrates competency in 5 or 6 attributes of the skill.
 iii. Performance level 2 (PL 2) (Approaching Expectation) where the learner
 correctly demonstrates competency in 3 or 4 attributes of the skill.
 iv. Performance Level 1 (PL 1) (Below Expectation) where the learner correctly
 demonstrates competency in 1 or 2 of the attributes of the skill or demonstrates
 competency in none of the attributes prescribed.
Scoring Guide for Task 2: Assessment of the Core Competency of self-efficacy (3 marks)
 1. Use the checklist provided to assess learners’ demonstration of the core competency
 of self efficacy as the learner interacts with teachers and peers and as they perform
 the assessment task.
 2. Rate each learner’s demonstration of the core competency of communication and
 collaboration under four performance levels as follows:
 i. Performance Level 4 (PL 4) (Exceeding Expectations) where the learner exhibits 3
 or more attributes of the core competency targeted.
 ii. Performance Level 3 (PL 3) (Meeting Expectations) where the learner exhibits 2 of
 the attributes of the core competency targeted.
 iii. Performance level 2 (PL 2) (Approaching Expectations) where the learner exhibits
 only 1 of the attributes of the core competency targeted.

 iv. Performance Level 1 (PL 1) (Below Expectations) where the learner exhibits none
 of the attributes of the core competency targeted.
Scoring Guide for Task 3: Javelin throw in athletics (7 marks)
1. Use the Observation checklist provided to assess each learner as they perform the assessment
 task.
2. Rate the learner’s competency in performing Javelin throw in athletics under four
 performance levels as follows:
 i. Performance Level 4 (PL 4) (Exceeding Expectation) where the learner
 demonstrates competency in all the 7 attributes of the skill correctly.
 ii. Performance Level 3 (PL 3) (Meeting Expectation) where the learner correctly.
 demonstrates competency in 5 or 6 attributes of the skill
 iii. Performance level 2 (PL 2) (Approaching Expectation) where the learner correctly
 demonstrates competency in 3 or 4 attributes of the skill.
 iv. Performance Level 1 (PL 1) (Below Expectation) where the learner correctly
 demonstrates competency in 1 or 2 of the attributes of the skill or demonstrates
 competency in none of the attributes prescribed.
Scoring Guide for Task 4: Assessment of the learner’s acquisition of the value of unity
(3 marks).
 1. Use the checklist provided to assess learners’ demonstration of the value of unity as the
 learner interacts with teachers and peers and as they perform the assessment task.
 2. Rate each learner’s demonstration of the demonstration of the value of unity under four
 performance levels as follows:
 i. Performance Level 4 (PL 4) (Exceeding Expectations) where the learner exhibits 3
 or more attributes of the value of unity.
 ii. Performance Level 3 (PL 3) (Meeting Expectations) where the learner exhibits 2 of
 the attributes of the value of unity.
 iii. Performance level 2 (PL 2) (Approaching Expectations) where the learner exhibits
 only 1 of the attributes of the value of unity.

 iv. Performance Level 1 (PL 1) (Below Expectations) where the learner exhibits none
 of the attributes of the value of unity.
